domain.description: The domain for which the cookie is valid. This attribute is optional (any domain).

path.description: The subset of URLs to which this cookie applies. This attribute is optional (all paths).

secure.description: Indicates to the browser whether the cookie should only be sent using a secure protocol, such as HTTPS or SSL.

httpOnly.description:
HttpOnly cookies are not supposed to be exposed to client-side scripting code, and may therefore help mitigate
certain kinds of cross-site scripting attacks.

maxAge.description:
This attribute defines the lifetime of the cookie, in seconds. After this time elapses, the client must discard
 the cookie. A value of zero means the cookie should be discarded immediately.

vers.description: Cookie version, defaults to version 1 (RFC 2109). This is a required value.
